verses.text: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?
lines: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth?
Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

verses.text: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,
lines: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow,
as a hireling who looks for his wages,

verses.text: so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
lines: so am I made to possess months of misery,
wearisome nights are appointed to me.

verses.text: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
lines: When I lie down, I say,
‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’
I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

verses.text: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
lines: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust.
My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

verses.text: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
lines: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle,
and are spent without hope.

verses.text: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
lines: Oh remember that my life is a breath.
My eye will no more see good.

verses.text: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
lines: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more.
Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

verses.text: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.
lines: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away,
so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

verses.text: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
lines: He will return no more to his house,
neither will his place know him any more.

verses.text: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
lines: “Therefore I will not keep silent.
I will speak in the anguish of my spirit.
I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.text: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
lines: Am I a sea, or a sea monster,
that you put a guard over me?

verses.text: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint;’
lines: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me.
My couch will ease my complaint;’

verses.text: then you scare me with dreams, and terrify me through visions:
lines: then you scare me with dreams,
and terrify me through visions:

verses.text: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
lines: so that my soul chooses strangling,
death rather than my bones.

verses.text: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
lines: I loathe my life.
I don’t want to live forever.
Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

verses.text: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
lines: What is man, that you should magnify him,
that you should set your mind on him,

verses.text: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
lines: that you should visit him every morning,
and test him every moment?

verses.text: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
lines: How long will you not look away from me,
nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

verses.text: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?
lines: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men?
Why have you set me as a mark for you,
so that I am a burden to myself?

verses.text: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”
lines: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity?
For now will I lie down in the dust.
You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”
